newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares gain slightly amid light trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares gain slightly amid light trade.

text.p: Lithuanian shares were steady on Monday in light trade, dealers said.
Overall central market volume was just over two million litas and the group A index, which tracks the bourse's most active listings, rose slightly by 4.05 points to 2,721.81.
The only significant price movement involved Rokishkis Cheese, which saw its shares rise to 55.00 from 50.00 litas in trade of almost 256,000 litas.
The banking sector remained quiet as investors wait for 1996 final results. Bloc trades worth almost 850,000 litas were also made on Monday.
